title: Source-awaiting owner-operable foundation

heldDecisions.decision: Select and accept the site source that will become maintained repository source.
heldDecisions.availableRoute: Prepare the neutral foundation and keep the source-intake Issue current.
heldDecisions.releaseEvent: The preparing owner supplies or accepts a named source coordinate for intake.

heldDecisions.decision: Choose the receiving repository identity, rights, visibility, and collaborator access.
heldDecisions.availableRoute: Prepare source, Issues, orientation, and an owner-readable settings checklist while account state remains with its current owner.
heldDecisions.releaseEvent: The receiving owner records the chosen repository identity and access posture.

heldDecisions.decision: Supply credentials and approve account-level repository settings through the authorized platform route.
heldDecisions.availableRoute: Record declared secret names, observable settings, and the exact owner action while values stay in their authorized systems.
heldDecisions.releaseEvent: The account owner completes or explicitly authorizes the named settings action.

heldDecisions.decision: Review and accept any repository ownership transfer.
heldDecisions.availableRoute: Prepare the useful repository, recovery coordinate, live Issue route, and pre-transfer receipt.
heldDecisions.releaseEvent: The preparing and receiving owners accept and complete or explicitly authorize the transfer.

heldDecisions.decision: Choose public visibility, publication timing, hosting route, and domain configuration.
heldDecisions.availableRoute: Keep a private, inspectable repository and prepare source-grounded publication options after intake.
heldDecisions.releaseEvent: The receiving owner selects a publication route and grants its preparation or activation.

heldDecisions.decision: Accept license and attribution carriers and authorize any destructive recovery action.
heldDecisions.availableRoute: Preserve incoming notices and the last known-good coordinate while preparing a reviewed decision.
heldDecisions.releaseEvent: The repository owner accepts the named carriers or explicitly authorizes the exact recovery action.

nextOwnerAction: Supply or accept the site source coordinate, then begin the source-intake Issue before selecting application tooling.

projection.derivationNote: The YAML companion is a byte-for-byte copy of this authoritative JSON document; JSON syntax is valid YAML 1.2.
